heldoutROP.definition: Observed ROP regression on a different well; not lithology or boundary accuracy.

audit.filter: finite; 1<ROP<=300 m/h; WOB>2 kN; RPM>=20; torque>=0; flow>0; no interpolation
audit.aggregation: Mirror: median per 1 m MD bin in inferred drilling states. rop_calc and inferred geology are not used.

calibration: N→kN /1000; c/s→r/min ×60; m/s→m/h ×3600; N.m→kN.m /1000; m3/s→L/s ×1000; drilling time=60/ROP only for positive active ROP. MD is not TVD.
